Meatball Pizza

Allergen Call Out: Wheat, Milk, Egg

Pre-bake ingredients, bottom to top

  1. 1 ea. Pizza Dough Ball [BOOM 0101]
  2. 85 g Grande Cheese Shredded Mozzarella
  3. 150 g Pizza Sauce [BOOM 0002]
  4. 8 ea. Fresh Mozzarella
  5. 1 ea. TILL Meatball [TILL022], Crumbled
  6. 7 g Calabrian Chiles
  7. 6 ea. TILL Garlic Confit [TILL011], smashed

Post bake, in order

  1. 4 g Basil
  2. 2 g Grated Romano Cheese
